summary:
P1.4a Core profile model complete — AlembicCore commit 8771524 on main (no push/tag/version bump). Added the §12.3 context-profile axis (cold-start | opportunistic) to the RecipeAuthoringSpec module's validateAgainst + renderGuidance, the producer foundation for the P1.4b in-process flatten.

WHAT SHIPPED:
- types/recipeAuthoringSpec.ts: RecipeAuthoringProfile = 'cold-start' | 'opportunistic'.
- gateRules.ts validateAgainst: ValidateAgainstOptions.profile (default 'cold-start'). cold-start = the full gate, byte-identical to today, and the DEFAULT — so the already-accepted Plugin stage-1/2 and Core stage-3 consumers (which call validateAgainst WITHOUT a profile) are unaffected. opportunistic gates OFF exactly two stage-2 checks: the 3-distinct-files evidence floor (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) and the session-scope port (SESSION_NOT_FOUND/WRONG_SCOPE). Every content gate (stage 1) + the cheap grounding (SOURCE_REFS_MISSING, SOURCE_REF_LINE_MISSING, fs resolution, placeholder, SNIPPET_MISMATCH, graph) + stage-3 still run identically — a DECLARED lighter bar, not a relaxation.
- gateRules.ts resolveAuthoringProfile(): byte-faithful mirror of the live shouldRunRecipeEvidenceGate (recipe-evidence-gate.ts:101) — session OR string sessionId/bootstrapSessionRef OR requireProductionSession===true OR string args.dimensionId OR any item with string dimensionId → cold-start; else opportunistic. The host resolves the session then passes the profile.
- guidanceGenerator.ts renderGuidance(path, stage?, profile='cold-start'): drops exactly the rules the opportunistic gate skips (evidence-floor + session-scope) from both the rules array and the rendered text, so guidance==gate per profile; cold-start text is byte-identical to before; GuidanceBlock now carries the profile.
- Exposed resolveAuthoringProfile + RecipeAuthoringProfile via the module barrel + the @alembic/core/knowledge facade.

COLD-START BYTE-IDENTICAL PROOF: cold-start is the default, so the existing P1 suites — RecipeAuthoringSpec (stage-1/2 validateAgainst), UnifiedValidatorStage3ByteIdentical, RecipeAuthoringSpecDrift, RecipeGateEnforcementMatrix — all pass unchanged (they call without a profile). The new test additionally asserts validateAgainst(items, {…}) === validateAgainst(items, {…, profile:'cold-start'}) on a corpus that actually triggers the floor + session-scope (zero change).

OPPORTUNISTIC PROOF (new RecipeAuthoringProfile test): a combo candidate that triggers content gates + the floor + session-scope shows opportunistic === cold-start MINUS exactly {INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, SESSION_NOT_FOUND} (full-array equality via cold.filter), keeping DO_CLAUSE_NON_IMPERATIVE / DONT_CLAUSE_REQUIRED / CONTENT_CONTRAST_MISSING / STAGE3_MARKDOWN_TOO_SHORT; a separate case proves SOURCE_REF_LINE_MISSING (cheap grounding) is kept in opportunistic; resolveAuthoringProfile mirrors all shouldRunRecipeEvidenceGate branches; renderGuidance opportunistic drops the evidence-floor + session-scope rules and the 证据下限 text while keeping the content rules + the 45-verb allowlist.

ACCEPTANCE (node 22.22.1): Core build PASS; build:check PASS; new profile test PASS; existing P1 golden-corpus + stage-3 byte-identical + drift + matrix tests stay green (cold-start default); full suite 1479/1479 (154 files); biome lint 682 files clean. Per the task's green bar (build:check + test + drift) — fully met. npm run check red ONLY on the 3 pre-existing out-of-scope lint:naming files (project-context-capabilities.ts, recipe-context-capabilities.ts, test-fixtures.ts) — the task-authorized carve-out; NOT touched.
verification: vitest test/RecipeAuthoringProfile.test.ts → PASS (cold-start==omit-profile zero-change; opportunistic==cold-start minus exactly {INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE,SESSION_NOT_FOUND}; grounding kept; resolveAuthoringProfile mirrors shouldRunRecipeEvidenceGate; renderGuidance profile)

vitest existing P1 suites (RecipeAuthoringSpec + UnifiedValidatorStage3ByteIdentical + RecipeAuthoringSpecDrift + RecipeGateEnforcementMatrix) → PASS unchanged (cold-start default = byte-identical proof)
npm run check → all stages PASS except lint:naming, red ONLY on the 3 pre-existing out-of-scope files (task-authorized carve-out)
risks: Opportunistic-scope interpretation: I implemented the LITERAL task spec — opportunistic drops EXACTLY two named checks (the 3-distinct-files evidence floor INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and session-scope). SOURCE_REFS_MISSING (requires ≥1 ref) is KEPT (it is not the 3-file floor) — the most conservative, least-relaxing reading. If the controller intends opportunistic to also make sourceRefs fully optional, that is a one-line follow-up; flagged for confirmation.

This is the PRODUCER axis only (P1.4a). The P1.4b in-process re-point (AlembicAgent + main-body GatewayActionRegistry call validateAgainst({profile: resolveAuthoringProfile(...)}) before gateway.create) is a separate downstream wave with producer-prompt-first discipline — NOT in this commit.
npm run check red on the 3 pre-existing public-export naming files is the task-authorized carve-out; NOT touched (rename breaks @alembic/core/* export contract; SN4 config-exception territory).

renderGuidance gained a 3rd optional param (profile, default cold-start) and GuidanceBlock gained a profile field — additive; all existing callers (buildSubmissionSpec, spec-shape/facade tests) pass without change.
Commit 8771524 is local only (no push), consistent with main-only/no-push; controller verification is local.
